cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd only be your name-reader. Those eighty wedding cards could show off your lettering; I've left all the ink colours out for you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like calligraphy. I hate copying guest lists.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll read each name and stack the finished cards. You choose the lettering, and no one gets to alter it after you're done.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your aunt will complain if I use purple.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me one purple sample and I'll make it the approved design. Your aunt can bring her complaints to me. Would you like to letter the rest?
